dutyRoster.title: Duty roster · {{ week }}
dutyRoster.subtitle: Click any cell to cycle the shift: unassigned → day → evening → night → flexible → off
dutyRoster.tableCaption: Duty roster grid: professionals down the side, days of the week across the top
dutyRoster.understaffed: Understaffed — fewer than three on duty
dutyRoster.empty: No professionals are rostered for this week.

plan.title: Plan a round
plan.hint: hc-professional owns the roster of record. The planner chooses who — by area, role, availability, workload and how near they are — and files the round there.
plan.name: Round name
plan.customersHint: Patient ids on the patient stack, comma separated. Leave empty for ward cover or on-call time — a round with no visits is valid.
plan.planned: Filed with the roster service — {{ name }}
plan.callFailed: The planning request did not reach the admin service. Nothing was filed. Try again, and check the console is signed in.
plan.rosterServiceDown: The roster service could not be reached, so the round was not filed. It is not on any clinician's roster — this is an outage, not an empty week.

reason.NO_TEAM_COVERS_THE_SPACE: Not staffed: no team covers that area. Add the area to a team's coverage first.
reason.NO_CANDIDATE_HOLDS_THE_ROLE: Not staffed: nobody on the covering teams holds that role.
reason.NO_CANDIDATE_IS_AVAILABLE: Not staffed: everybody with that role is on leave, rostered off or already has a round that day.
reason.ROSTER_SERVICE_UNREACHABLE: Not filed: the roster service could not be reached. {{ name }} has not been given this round.
reason.ROSTER_SERVICE_REFUSED_THE_ROUND: Not filed: the roster service refused the round — a visit time outside the shift window, or a clash with a round it already holds.
